title: Vault Credentials — Present
description: Present one stored credential to a verifier the consumer names, bound to that verifier and a nonce it chose, disclosing only the named claims.

id.description: Local handle from a query descriptor. Opaque; consumers must not derive or guess one.

audience.description: The verifier the presentation is for: the `domain` of a Data Integrity presentation, the `aud` of an SD-JWT key-binding JWT.

nonce.description: The value the verifier binds the presentation to: the `nonce` of a Data Integrity presentation or of an SD-JWT key-binding JWT.

claims.description: The names of the subject claims to disclose. Nothing outside them is disclosed; a credential that cannot disclose less than all its claims is refused unless they are all named.

purpose.description: Optional: why the holder is presenting, recorded with the maintainer's record of the disclosure. Never sent to the verifier.

anyOf.description: A W3C Verifiable Presentation carrying `nonce` and `domain` as members its holder's Data Integrity proof signs.
A compact SD-JWT presentation with a key-binding JWT carrying `nonce` and `aud`.

presentation.description: The presentation, to be carried to the verifier unchanged.

disclosed.description: The names of the subject claims the presentation discloses.
